title: Unit Event — Unreliable Notes — Episode6 In Extremis

meta.Event Outline: Kanade delves into the "warmth" Mafuyu feels from her music, hoping to identify its nature. When she learns it relates to a memory of Mafuyu's mother, she starts working on a new song, but finds something isn't right.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, you mean that asset I asked you to make?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, it just took longer than expected.
I'll send it over now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, this looks great! I'll try plopping this in now!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Alright... In that case, I'm gonna take a quick break.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Have fun♪
I've got lots more assets for you to make, so I'll tell you about them after you get back.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
<I guess we should take this opportunity to polish everything up really nicely, since K still seems to be busy.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Actually, speaking of her...
She's been staying offline to compose that song for you, Yuki, but I'm starting to get worried...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, she hasn't been on at all lately...
Knowing her, I'm worried she's not getting enough rest again.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Fortunately, Yuki's with her, so I'm sure she's at least getting something to eat.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She's been eating during the sporadic breaks she's been taking. But only very little...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Only a little? Are you sure she's okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<No, she's gonna collapse again!
You gotta tell her to eat more, Yuki!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't think she's heard a word I've said.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She just keeps mumbling that her song is all wrong.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I got worried and decided to see how Kanade was doing.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <She spent all of today working again, nonstop.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<But, why?
She's had a few slumps here and there, but nothing this bad, not recently...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What do you mean by that, Rin?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, Yuki, what was that sound just now?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How do I capture the warmth Mafuyu felt?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I still can't get it right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I have to find it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The sound that will save Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That voice. Where have I heard it before...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-Is everything okay? Are you looking for your mom...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I looked all over for you, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Didn't I tell you to never leave my side?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
As long as we're together, you'll be happy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: After all, I am your mother.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: H-Huh...? I can't move... My body...

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line: <You're pushing yourself way too hard, Kanade!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have Ena and Mizuki here on my phone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Are you alright, Kanade?
You should rest and give your body a chance to recover.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Also, Mafuyu was worried sick about you...
She told us you've hardly had anything to eat.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you all worry about me like this...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's okay. You don't need to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I mean, you're composing this song just for me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd rather you didn't push yourself so hard...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you feeling nauseous at all, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay...
But my head is spinning a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In that case, you should have something to eat.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I agree.
Something simple like rice porridge is probably your best option right now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I think I can handle that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, I'll go make some now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, you need to focus on resting right now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry. Would that be okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <While we wait, can we chat for a bit?>
